buns package.action: With my right hand, grab the buns package from the middle freezer drawer.
Put down the buns package on the countertop near the dishwasher.
Slide the plastic tray from the buns packaging to get the buns out of the plastic sleeve.
Pick up two buns from the plastic tray.
Put the buns pack into the middle freezer drawer.

frozen food package (unspecified).action: User grabs the frozen food package (unspecified) from the edge of the middle freezer drawer.
User sets the frozen food package (unspecified) back down flat inside the middle freezer drawer so the drawer can be closed.

coffee bag.action: User lifts a coffee bag from the middle shelf of the cupboard above the hob to inspect it.
User puts the coffee bag back in the cupboard by pushing it down flat on top of the box on the middle shelf.

User removes the clip from the coffee beans bag.
User opens the coffee beans bag by pulling the sides of the bag.
User scoops coffee beans from the coffee beans bag using a red coffee spoon.
User scoops a second spoonful of coffee beans from the coffee beans bag using the red coffee spoon.
User places the coffee beans bag back in a box in the middle shelf of the cupboard above the hob.
User picks up the coffee beans bag again from the middle shelf of the cupboard above the hob.
User places the coffee beans bag again in the middle shelf of the cupboard above the hob.

spanish tortilla leftovers.action: User retrieves the spanish tortilla leftovers from the middle shelf of the fridge.
User unwraps/removes the cling film from the plate containing the spanish tortilla leftovers.

bread.action: User picks up the bread from the top shelf of the fridge.
User unwraps/opens the bread plastic wrapping.
User takes the last slice of bread out of the bread packaging.
User discards the (now empty) bread packaging into the soft plastic recycling bin.

jar of peanut butter.action: User retrieves a jar of peanut butter from the middle shelf of the cupboard above the hob.
User puts down the jar of peanut butter on the table between the two tablecloths (not returned to storage).
